Instead of raising an issue you can create your own article by forking the website and updating it.  Then create a pull request so we can review the contents and approve it.

Alternatively provide us with the following:

## Category
Where do you want it to appear on the website. It can be in more than one place

## Title
A short unique title 

## Contents
Link to a google doc

## Media
Attach any files that you want to appear in the article. We prefer webp format images with compression or provide links.. but not imgur
